name: Archon of Undeath
description:
Your Minions deal more Damage. 
More Cooldown Recovery Rate for Command Skills. 
More Limit of Temporary Minion Skills.
keywordDefinition:
Archon of Undeath is a type of Archon Buff. It grants:
• 25% more Minion Damage
• 200% more Cooldown Recovery Rate for Command Skills
• Temporary Minion Skills have 100% more Limit of Minions summoned

When you gain Archon of Undeath all of your Persistent Undead Minions are revived.
